skill.name: vision-analysis
skill.description: Analyze images with the MiniMax vision MCP tool for description, OCR, UI review, chart reading, and object detection.
skill.summary: Use MiniMax vision analysis to understand images, screenshots, charts, and interface mockups.

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, setup examples, documented MiniMax endpoints, and placeholder API key names. No hidden command execution, secret harvesting, filesystem abuse, reconnaissance, or prompt injection was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Third-party image processing is only implicit in the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: State that image content is sent to MiniMax through the configured MCP service before analysis.

remediation.issue: Setup examples include persistent MCP configuration paths and commands.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to review commands and add configuration manually in their chosen client.

content.value_statement: Image-heavy work often needs fast description, OCR, and visual review. This skill routes images to MiniMax vision analysis with focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes image files or image URLs through the MiniMax_understand_image MCP tool.
Selects modes for description, OCR, UI review, chart reading, and object detection.
Extracts visible text from screenshots, documents, and other image content.
Reviews interface mockups and wireframes with structured design feedback.
Reads charts and graphs for visible labels, values, series, and trends.
Identifies visible objects, people, activities, and approximate locations in an image.
limitations: Requires a MiniMax Token Plan subscription and a valid API key.
Requires the MiniMax MCP tool to be configured before analysis can run.
Image content is processed by MiniMax through the configured MCP service.
OCR and chart extraction depend on image quality and readable text.

use_cases.title: Review Interface Mockups
use_cases.description: Get structured feedback on screenshots, wireframes, and visual layouts before implementation.

use_cases.title: Extract Text from Images
use_cases.description: Turn screenshot text into readable notes while preserving headings, lists, and visible structure.

use_cases.title: Understand Visual Evidence
use_cases.description: Summarize photos, diagrams, charts, and visual assets during documentation or support work.

prompt_templates.title: Describe an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this image: [image path or URL]. Describe the main subject, setting, visible text, colors, and notable objects.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Visible Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract all readable text from this image. Preserve headings, lists, and columns. Say when text is not readable.

prompt_templates.title: Review a UI Mockup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this interface image. List strengths, usability issues, visual hierarchy problems, and specific improvement suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Chart Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this chart image. Extract readable labels, values, series, and trends. Note uncertainty and missing information.

output_examples.input: A screenshot of a settings page with small labels and toggles.
output: Lists the visible section headings and field labels.
Summarizes the page purpose and layout.

output_examples.input: A mobile app wireframe for checkout.
output: Identifies strengths in flow, spacing, and calls to action.
Flags confusing steps or weak visual priority.
Suggests concrete layout and copy improvements.

output_examples.input: A chart image showing quarterly revenue by region.
output: Extracts readable title, axes, labels, and series names.
Calls out values that cannot be read confidently.

best_practices: Use clear image paths or direct image URLs supported by your MCP setup.
Choose a specific mode when you need OCR, chart data, or UI review.
Review sensitive images before sending them to the configured MiniMax service.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill before MiniMax MCP setup is complete.
Do not expect perfect OCR from blurry, cropped, or low-resolution images.
Do not send private images unless your data policy allows third-party processing.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes image files, image URLs, screenshots, diagrams, charts, mockups, and photos through MiniMax vision.

faq.question: Does it require a MiniMax account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a MiniMax Token Plan subscription and a valid MiniMax API key.

faq.question: Can it extract text from screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. Use OCR mode to extract visible text and preserve readable structure.

faq.question: Can it review UI designs?
faq.answer: Yes. UI review mode provides strengths, issues, and improvement suggestions for mockups and wireframes.

faq.question: Does it work with local files?
faq.answer: Yes, if your MiniMax MCP configuration has access to the local image path.

faq.question: Are images sent to a third party?
faq.answer: Yes. Image analysis runs through the configured MiniMax MCP service.
